plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} complained about the food at every meal and still went back for seconds.
I don't have the right words. {OTHER_nameDef} always did.
{OTHER_nameDef} hauled the stone for most of these walls. We'll keep them standing.
{OTHER_nameDef} stayed through the raids and the hungry seasons, and never talked about leaving.
[longtime] {OTHER_nameDef} was with us for {YEARS} years. Most of what we have, {OTHER_nameDef} helped build.
[titled] {OTHER_nameDef} never asked to be called {TITLE}. It stuck because it was true.
[unfinished] {OTHER_nameDef} wanted to {GOAL}, and ran out of time. Some of us will try to finish it.
[battle] {FACTION} did this. {OTHER_nameDef} stood out in front when they came, so the rest of us didn't have to.
[battle] {OTHER_nameDef} died holding the line, and the line held.
[deadchild] There's nothing I can say over a child's grave that will help. I keep listening for that laugh out in the yard.
[deadold] {OTHER_nameDef} saw more winters than any of us, and taught the rest of us how to get through them.
[kin] {OTHER_nameDef} was my family. We fought like family, and we looked after each other like family.
[partner] I woke up every day next to {OTHER_nameDef}. I don't know how to wake up any other way.
[stranger] I didn't know {OTHER_nameDef} well, and I wish I had.
[rival] {OTHER_nameDef} and I fought about everything. I'd give a lot for one more argument.
[winter] It took four of us all morning to break the frozen ground for {OTHER_nameDef}.
[rain] {OTHER_nameDef} hated getting wet. I'm sorry we couldn't pick a better day for this.
{OTHER_nameDef} never asked for much more than a dry bed and a seat out of the wind in the evenings.
{OTHER_nameDef} always knew whose turn it was to wash the pots, and made sure they knew it too.
[stranger] I'm told {OTHER_nameDef} was good with the animals and hated mornings. I should have found that out for myself.
[stranger] Someone who knew {OTHER_nameDef} better should be standing here, but couldn't face it today. {OTHER_nameDef} was one of ours all the same.
[rival] I never liked {OTHER_nameDef}, and it was mutual. I'd still have trusted {OTHER_objective} with my life.
[rival] Most of the shouting around here was {OTHER_nameDef} and me. It's going to be very quiet now.
[kin] We had the same stubborn chin, {OTHER_nameDef} and I. I'll see it every time I look into still water.
[partner] We had small plans, a garden and a dog and a quiet old age. I'll keep the garden going.
[battle] {OTHER_nameDef} could have stayed inside when they came, and picked up a weapon instead.
[battle] {FACTION} came at us, and {OTHER_nameDef} met them at the gate. Some of us are only standing here because of that.
[deadchild] {OTHER_nameDef} should have grown up here, been bored here, fallen in love here and complained about chores.
[deadold] {OTHER_nameDef} told the same three stories every winter, and I know them all by heart. I'll tell them tonight, though not as well.
[titled] We called {OTHER_nameDef} {TITLE}. Ask anyone here how that name was earned.
[unfinished] {OTHER_nameDef} was going to {GOAL}. I'll take that up, if I can.
[longtime] {OTHER_nameDef} was here before most of us. {YEARS} years of early mornings and late suppers.
[night] We're burying {OTHER_nameDef} by torchlight. None of us wanted to leave {OTHER_objective} lying out there until morning.
[summer] It's a fine day. {OTHER_nameDef} would have been out in the fields in it, hat pulled down against the sun.
[old] I've buried too many people younger than me, and now {OTHER_nameDef}.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} made this place feel like a home and not a camp. Thank you, {OTHER_nameDef}.
[partner] I loved {OTHER_nameDef}, and I told {OTHER_objective} so most days. I'm glad I did.
[unfinished] {OTHER_nameDef} wanted to {GOAL}. I'm going to try, for {OTHER_objective}.
I hope wherever {OTHER_nameDef} is now, it's warm and the food is good. Rest well, {OTHER_nameDef}.
[partner] {OTHER_nameDef} made me kinder than I was. I'll try to stay that way.
[deadchild] Little {OTHER_nameDef}, who followed the animals around and gave every one of them a name.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was good at the work and good to the people here. That's all I've got.
[battle] {FACTION} took {OTHER_nameDef}. Next time they come, they'll find out what that cost them.
[rival] We didn't get on, and you all know it. {OTHER_nameDef} was still one of ours.
{OTHER_nameDef} pulled {OTHER_possessive} weight every day. Let's get the grave filled.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} made me laugh every day. I'll try to do the same for you lot, though I won't be half as good at it.
{OTHER_nameDef} would hate all this crying. Let's tell the one about {OTHER_nameDef} and the muffalo and the latrine instead.
[longtime] {YEARS} years of terrible jokes from {OTHER_nameDef}, and I laughed at nearly every one.

gloomy.li: We're all heading where {OTHER_nameDef} has gone. {OTHER_nameDef} just got there first, and left us the work.
[deadchild] We were supposed to keep the children safe. We didn't.
[lowmood] I don't have anything comforting to say. {OTHER_nameDef} is gone, and the rim won't even notice.
[unfinished] {OTHER_nameDef} wanted to {GOAL}. It was never going to happen out here.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was reliable and competent, and no one here can do that work as well. We are weaker today.
[battle] {OTHER_nameDef} fell to {FACTION}. I've added that to the ledger.
{OTHER_nameDef}'s duties will be reassigned by morning. Finding someone who does them as well will take longer.
[titled] {OTHER_nameDef} was called {TITLE}, and the name goes into the annals. That will have to do.
